name: Elegant Casting

components.pose: She stands in a dramatic lunge, weight over her front leg, one arm thrown out to the side with an open palm releasing a rolling wave of flame, the other hand drawn back at her shoulder shaping a bright ball of fire between her fingers, torso arched, chin lifted, a fierce, confident gaze to the camera. A hot, gusting wind whips her gown, hem and hair upward. No weapon or staff - casting with her bare hands only.
components.effects: Rolling {{MAGIC}} flames and a glowing ball of fire spin around her hands, embers streaming on the wind.

notes: Elegant casting: unique gown that fits her magic, hands-only complex casting stance with wind.
